messages:
Priya: Heads-up: March US-west GPU invoice is ~22% over forecast; there's an ~$18k bucket showing as `unlabeled` under project=ephemeral-runner-01.
Anya: That's the new CI autoscale pool we enabled last week.
Ben: Confirmed. Autoscaler didn't scale down some spot nodes due to a `min_nodes` override; those instances kept accruing charges. I've opened infra ticket INF-2026-110 and am harvesting instance IDs.
Luis: Repro steps: the deploy accidentally set `min_nodes: 2` for the us-west spot pool. `kubectl get hpa -n infra-autoscale` shows the mismatch. I've reverted the override and pushed rev 3a7f with a guard.
Priya: We need retro attribution so chargebacks don't hit `unlabeled`. Finance, what's the process for reallocating historical charges?
finance-bot: Reclassification window = 30 days. Submit a #finance ticket with CSV: (instance_id, owner_team, amount, invoice_id). The automation will apply adjustments on next chargeback run.
Ben: I'll run a backfill against billing export and map instance_id -> PR/owner. BigQuery snippet I used: `SELECT resource.labels.instance_id, SUM(cost) FROM `billing.gcp_export.ga_billing_*` WHERE invoice_month='2026-03' AND labels.autoscale_pool='ephemeral-runner-01' GROUP BY resource.labels.instance_id;` Will drop CSV to shared sheet.
Anya: If we get this before EOD we can adjust budgets pre-close. Also consider alert tuning so CI pools don't blow budgets again.
Priya: Filing the finance ticket now; will attach Ben's CSV when ready. Also flagging vendor credit only if this is recurring.
Ben: Backfill running, ETA ~3h. Sheet link when done.
Luis: Monitoring autoscaler for two cycles; added tests to prevent `min_nodes` regressions.
Priya: Action list: Ben -> CSV & sheet; Priya -> finance ticket; Luis -> monitor; Anya -> alert tuning. Follow up in this thread once ticket processes. :white_check_mark:
